Sorry, Isai just crashed. This should not happen. Please send an error report to the developer so the problem can be fixed!

All data contained in the report will be kept strictly confidential and only used to identify the problem.
You can add a comment here, e.g. to describe which action produced the error:

Isai is a lyrics and guitar chords viewer for live worship performance. 

It fetches your song library from a URL you configure in Settings, caches it locally for offline use, and displays lyrics with guitar chords in a clean, readable format. 

Features 
• Auto-scroll with adjustable speed, pause, and stop controls 
• Transpose chords up or down by semitone 
• Capo indicator when a song specifies a capo fret 
• Offline cache refreshed on a configurable schedule 
• Full-text search across titles, lyrics, and composer fields 
• QR code import to configure the songs URL 

Isai requests the INTERNET permission to download your song library. If a crash occurs, the app will offer to send an error report to help fix the problem. Any data sent will be kept confidential and used only to identify the issue.
Please allow this app to access the camera in order to scan the QR code.
You rejected the camera permission, so the QR code cannot be scanned.
